title: Jump Game V
description: Given an array of integers arr and an integer d, return the maximum number of jumps you can make starting from any index, jumping to an index i+k or i-k such that arr[i] > arr[j] and |i-j| <= d.
pseudocode:
1. let dp = new Array(n).fill(1)
2. let indices = arr.map((v, i) => [v, i]).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
3. for [val, i] of indices:
4.   for offset from -d to d:
5.     let j = i + offset
6.     if (j >= 0 && j < n && arr[j] < arr[i]):
7.       dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i], 1 + dp[j])

steps.note: Sort indices by value: arr=[6, 4, 14], d=2
Check jumps from index 1. Can jump to index 0 (val 6 > 4 is false) and index 2 (val 14 > 4 is false).
Jump to index 1 (val 4 < 6). Update dp[0] = max(1, 1 + dp[1]) = 2
Jump to index 1 (val 4 < 14). Update dp[2] = max(1, 1 + dp[1]) = 2
